mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dashboard_widget ( code, name, description, widget_type, data_source, data_source_config, default_config, available_dimensions, required_role_codes, status, created_by ) VALUES ( #{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{widgetType}, #{dataSource}, #{dataSourceConfig}::jsonb, #{defaultConfig}::jsonb, #{availableDimensions,typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.media.mapper.StringArrayTypeHandler}, #{requiredRoleCodes,typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.media.mapper.StringArrayTypeHandler}, COALESCE(#{status},'ACTIVE'), #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE dashboard_widget SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, widget_type = #{widgetType}, data_source = #{dataSource}, data_source_config = #{dataSourceConfig}::jsonb, default_config = #{defaultConfig}::jsonb, available_dimensions = #{availableDimensions,typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.media.mapper.StringArrayTypeHandler}, required_role_codes = #{requiredRoleCodes,typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.media.mapper.StringArrayTypeHandler}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dashboard_widget SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, description, widget_type, data_source, data_source_config::text AS data_source_config, default_config::text AS default_config, available_dimensions, required_role_codes, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM dashboard_widget WHERE id = #{id}
